title: nan
authors: García S.; López M.E.; Barea R.; Bergasa L.M.; Gómez A.; Molinos E.J.
key_contribution: Presents a ROS-based monocular visual SLAM and IMU EKF fusion system for micro aerial vehicle (MAV) 6DOF pose estimation in unknown GPS-denied indoor environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
